headline: Correcting RNA degradation and hashtag demultiplexing in single-cell transcriptomics
label: Single Cell Transcriptome Methods
summary: Recent methods address scRNA-seq batch integration metrics, unsupervised clustering, hashtag demultiplexing and per-cell transcript start quantification.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational correction and evaluation of single-cell transcriptomic measurements, with method development and benchmarking targeting distinct sources of technical variation. A systematic evaluation of scRNA-seq batch integration metrics introduces sBEE, a metric combining neighborhood composition, tested on synthetic scenarios. scATS corrects RNA degradation bias in 5' scRNA-seq to quantify alternative transcription start sites per cell, with a lung cancer relevance score pipeline. CMDdemux applies CLR normalization, K-medoids clustering and Mahalanobis classification to hashtag-labelled data, while a k-MST graph algorithm and an autoencoder-based Gaussian mixture alternative address unsupervised cell clustering. What is new is degradation-corrected per-cell start-site quantification and a neighborhood-based integration metric. TUSCO, AMD co-expression analysis and housekeeping gene normalization are bulk or long-read work and only loosely related.
